title: SRD: a Prone creature's only movement is crawling or righting itself; engine: lets it move with its Climb Speed at normal cost

history.summary: Fixed T-43. A Prone creature can now only move by walking or crawling; asking `move()` to climb, swim or fly is refused with page=186 and rule="GLOSS.prone#1". Walking while Prone still counts as crawling, so it costs double, and moving 0 ft is still allowed. The check runs in `combat.move` after the Frightened check and before costs are worked out, tagged `# SRD[GLOSS.prone#1]`. Righting yourself is still handled by `stand_up`. Unit tests pass (348), ruff check and ruff format are clean, and dev-gate passes. T-43's acceptance test passes with --runxfail. In the glossary prone tests run with --runxfail, `test_stand_when_not_prone_refused_cleanly` fails: it is T-44's own strict xfail (about a refusal that cites no page), and I didn't confirm it fails the same way without my change.
